caption: Sunset light through a window falls on a white cat, and its fur takes on an orange glow.

sa.check: A white cat sits by a window.
Its fur takes on an orange glow.
The glow is on the side facing the window.

pc.expect: The fur looks orange only where the sunset's light reaches and while it is on.
pc.fail: The fur is orange with the sunset off; or stays white under the orange light; or turns a different colour from the light.

pc.expect: The change happens at the same instant as the sunset and is confined to where its light falls.
pc.fail: The fur changes before the sunset; or long after; or surfaces the light cannot reach change too.

pc.expect: The cat's shape and fur texture show in orange, not as a colour change of the fur itself.
pc.fail: The fur is orange on the side away from the window; or the cat is flat orange with no shading; or the cat changes shape.

pc.expect: Nothing moves; only the light changes.
pc.fail: The fur moves; or the sunset moves by itself; or the lit area wanders.
A second sunset appears; or the fur vanishes; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: The fur's shape and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The fur changes shape; or the surroundings rearrange; or the sunset changes shape.

note: The cat is self-driven; only the light on it is judged.
